comment: Pinned GigaAM artefacts, verified by `make gigaam-setup` before a demo so
that the normal worker start stays offline.
The checkpoint md5 equals _MODEL_HASHES in the official gigaam/__init__.py,
which is the value gigaam itself asserts in load_model. The sha256 digests
are ours and also cover the tokenizer, for which upstream publishes none.
